description: POS Customer Order History & Reorder is an Odoo Point of Sale extension designed to simplify repeat sales and improve checkout efficiency. A dedicated popup opens, listing all past POS orders linked to the selected customer in a structured and easy-to-read format. The order list is presented in a clean, searchable, and structured layout, including essential details such as order reference, order number, order date and time, customer name, total amount, and payment status.
